notes_for_us: The player picks one of several stages and one of several environments, so the deliverable is a set of interchangeable maps. The handoff holds one shape and one map, and P4 means zones you travel between, not variants you choose between. This is a different thing and it has no representation.

Performance Venue exists because the crowd faces one way, and this prompt may have no crowd at all - the audience is a camera and the viewers are elsewhere. The preset is still right about the stage and wrong about the room, and taking it whole puts bleachers into a music-video studio.

A composed camera position is the actual deliverable of this game. vignette-photo is the closest thing we have and it is described as a screenshot spot; recording a performance wants framing that belongs to neither the image stream nor the placement pass.

notes_for_us: Obby and Infinite Runner are separated by whether forward motion is automatic, and no user says. This prompt says i run, which is agency, and oncoming cars, which is a runner. The genre boundary note is clear and the prompt simply cannot answer it, so the classification is a coin flip that changes what gets generated.
Is there an end to this is listed as the one sanctioned shape question, and here it decides the genre rather than the shape. Worth saying in step 4 that the answer can move the classification.

Lane Runner is the preset with traffic and it is lane-snap; Free Runner is the free-steering one and it has no traffic. Any road-crossing prompt has to break one of them, and the swap rule makes the record say Lane Runner for a build with no lanes.
